glosses: colleague (fellow member of a profession or staff)
mate (a comrade or fellow with whom an activity or place is shared)

examples.text: Tom é meu colega de classe.
examples.en: Tom is a classmate of mine.

examples.text: Não posso falar pelos meus colegas.
examples.en: I can't speak for my colleagues.

examples.text: Não fale mal de seus colegas.
examples.en: Don't speak ill of your classmates.
